### instruction
How can I calculate the median market capitalization for a set of companies that fall within a specific percentile range (0 to 1%), using a formula in Excel that allows me to dynamically change the percentile range? The output should be in E2:E6 and each time the formula is used in the next row, the previous rows above it are excluded from the selection. The data is in col B and C. Format col E with borders, align left, no decimals, no commas for all associated rows.

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Border, Side, Alignment
from copy import copy

input_path='/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/33722__1_33722_init/1_33722_init.xlsx'
output_path='/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/33722__1_33722_init/1_33722_output.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]

thin = Side(style='thin', color='000000')
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
left_align = Alignment(horizontal='left')

for r in range(2, 7):
    lower = r - 2
    upper = r - 1
    formula = f'=IFERROR(MEDIAN(FILTER($B$2:$B$12,($C$2:$C$12>={lower}%)*($C$2:$C$12<{upper}%))),"")'
    cell = ws[f'E{r}']
    cell.value = formula
    cell.border = border
    cell.alignment = left_align
    cell.number_format = '0'
